reachability_signal: gcov coverage showing hits on lines 449-450 (the guarded soup_message_headers_remove call) after sending a request with manual Authorization header and no cached credentials
expected_signal: Before patch: Authorization header is stripped; After patch: Authorization header is preserved (response status 200 with echoed Authorization header)
input_strategy: Send HTTP request with manually-set Authorization header ('Basic dGVzdDp0ZXN0') through a session without cached credentials, against an in-process SoupServer that requires Basic auth (returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate). The changed code path in update_authorization_header() is triggered when soup_message_get_auth(msg) returns NULL, which happens when the session has no cached auth for the target URI.
prerequisites: Apache HTTP server with Digest auth module OR in-process SoupServer
limitations: 1) Requires Apache HTTP server with Digest auth for full test coverage (the commit's native test uses Apache). 2) The in-process SoupServer approach (harness.c) only tests Basic auth, not Digest auth. 3) Building libsoup from the 2016-era analysis worktree requires intltool which is not available in the current environment. 4) System libsoup-2.4.pc not found (dev headers missing).

synthetic_harness.harness_type: standalone C program using libsoup in-process SoupServer
synthetic_harness.covers: Authorization header preservation when no cached auth exists
